name: RedBot RPC Control
description: Control Red-DiscordBot via its official JSON-RPC (status, join/leave VC, play/skip/stop). Opt-in by design: use only when the user explicitly asks for Red.

rpcUrl.description: WebSocket URL for Red RPC (default ws://172.17.0.1:6134 — the Docker bridge gateway; port 6134 is a socat forwarder to Red's loopback-only 6133)

usageHint.description: Text prepended to every redbot_* tool description to steer the model. Default restricts the tools to explicit Red/Redbot requests; extend it if your agent has its own music tools the model should prefer.
